P.name: Moonsilver Blade
P.title: Template:Data Diana/Moonsilver Blade
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Moonsilver Blade|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Diana
|skill        = I
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Moonsilver Blade.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Diana}} gains {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}, increased shortly after casting an ability.
|blurb2       = Every third basic attack in quick succession will cleave nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Diana''' gains {{as|{{sti|attack speed|{{pplevel|15 to 35|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. After casting an {{tip|ability}}, this bonus is tripled to {{pplevel|15*3 to 35*3|key=%|color=as}} for 5 seconds.
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Moonsilver Blade:}} '''Diana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}}  of ''Moonsilver Blade'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, '''Diana''' empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them {{pplevel|20+5*(x-1) for 6; then + 10*x for 5; then + 15*x for 5; then + 25*x|formula=20 + 5 per level until level 6, then + 10 per level until level 11, then + 15 per level until level 16, then + 25 per level|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. ''Moonsilver Blade'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|effect radius= <!--cr or er?-->175
|affects      = Self / Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = true
|parry        = true
|notes        =
* ''Moonsilver Blade'' will affect {{tip|structures}}.
* Each attack has a distinct animation and she will glow when the empowered attack is ready.
* When the stacks are consumed {{tip|on-hit}} (e.g {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}, {{ii|Dusk and Dawn}}), additional damage is only applied to the on-hit target, without triggering the cleave on nearby enemies. [https://www.reddit.com/r/DianaMains/comments/u7hlez/guinsoos_rageblade_interaction_with_dianas/]
* Sometimes, the empowered basic attack will not consume the stacks.{{bug|1}}
** In this case, the attack will also not deal its damage.
}}

E.name: Lunar Rush
E.title: Template:Data Diana/Lunar Rush
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Lunar Rush|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Diana
|skill        = E
|icon         = Lunar Rush.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Diana}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} to an enemy and deals {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = If used on a target afflicted with {{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana|''Moonlight''}}, the cooldown is massively {{sti|ah|reduced}}. 
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them {{as|magic damage}} and consumes ''{{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana|Moonlight}}'' from all enemies. If the target is within 400 range, '''Diana''' will dash through their location.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
|description2 = If ''Moonlight'' is consumed from the target, ''Lunar Rush's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
|description3 = '''''Diana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''
|target range = 825
|cast time    = none
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 14}}
|cost         = {{ap|40 to 60}}
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = Single target
|callforhelp  = True
|spellshield  = True
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|notes        = 
* '''Diana''' will attempt to basic attack the target.
* ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown will also be reset if the target dies during the dash while being affected by ''Moonlight''.
* ''Lunar Rush'' consumes ''Moonlight'' upon ending the dash (even if {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}).
* ''Lunar Rush'' will still deal damage even if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} by the end of the dash.
* If ''Lunar Rush'' is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}} the ''Moonlight'' debuff is still consumed but ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown is not reset.
|tips         = 
* Since ''Moonlight'' is consumed upon ending the dash, a {{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana}} cast mid-dash can still cause a reset.
* ''Lunar Rush'' only consumes present ''Moonlight'' from the enemies. Because of this, it is possible for ''Lunar Rush'' to be reset multiple times during the same ''Crescent Strike'' cast, until it finishes its trajectory.
}}

R.name: Moonfall
R.title: Template:Data Diana/Moonfall
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Moonfall|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Diana
|skill        = R
|icon         = Moonfall.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Diana}} {{tip|airborne|draws}} in and {{tip|slow|slows}} nearby enemies.
|blurb2       = If she pulls an enemy {{tip|champion}}, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area after a delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, increased if she pulled more champions.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} all nearby enemies towards her, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
|description2 = If an enemy {{tip|champion}} is pulled, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area around her after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased for each champion pulled beyond the first.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Champion|{{ap|35 to 85}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Total Damage Vs. 5 Champions|{{ap|200+35*4 to 400+85*4}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|475|Effect radius}}|{{tt|225|Maximum Pull distance}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|100 to 80}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = special
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Diana_Original_R_0.ogg}} ''"Night approaches!"''
|notes        = 
* Enemies stay in the area for a maximum of approximately {{fd|0.5}} seconds while being pulled.
* {{tip|cc-immune|Crowd control immunity}} and {{tip|displacement immunity}} still count as being "pulled in" by the ability.
* {{tip|clone|Clones}} count as champions for increasing this ability's damage.
* ''Moonfall's'' additional damage is not capped at 4 champions.
* The beam of moonlight does not crash down if champions hit blocked the initial effect with {{tip|spell shield}}.
** Enemy champions protected by ''spell shield'' do not count towards the damage increase.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* A lunar phase of the moon will appear above '''Diana''' while she is casting ''Moonfall'', each phase is based on the number of enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} pulled:
